title: Ayanis andesite foundation under mud brick
summary: Matt tells of Ayanis andesite foundation under mud brick, about ancient / Urartian at Ayanis, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that's the foundation of ionas okay you're looking at now that is built out of an aite one of the hardest stones on Earth

plain: A researcher known as Matt, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024, shows the foundation of Ayanis, an ancient fortress site in eastern Turkey, which has mud brick walls on top. He says the foundation is made of andesite, which he calls one of the hardest stones on Earth. His point is that the base may come from more skilled, older builders than the walls above it.
